other.general_negative.title: Vague dissatisfaction with recent app updates
other.general_negative.description: Customers say the app became useless or worse after an update, expressing general anger and wanting to uninstall without naming a specific problem.
other.general_negative.note: Mixes broad update dissatisfaction, an unrelated boycott over a political issue, complaints about restrictions, and generic 'worst app' remarks.

usability.other.title: Removed features and intrusive premium prompts
usability.other.description: Customers report that updates removed basic player features such as skipping and replaying songs, and that premium promotions and ads are intrusive, leading some to uninstall.
usability.other.note: Mixes removed playback controls, premium upselling and ads, and general negative remarks about the app.

playback.crash_or_wont_open.title: App crashes or stays stuck on loading
playback.crash_or_wont_open.description: Customers say the app crashes after an update, will not open, or freezes on the loading or logo screen.

playback.other.title: Songs fail to play or voice commands fail
playback.other.description: Customers report that songs will not play, including when started through a voice assistant that announces a playlist but plays nothing.

usability.ads.title: Too many loud ads
usability.ads.description: Customers complain of excessive ads, some very loud, and feel pushed toward premium despite not wanting it.

usability.queue_playlist.title: Queue and playlist controls too restrictive
usability.queue_playlist.description: Customers say they cannot queue songs, choose tracks or shuffle freely, and are limited to skipping a few songs in a playlist they did not want.

billing.other.title: Cannot play chosen songs without shuffle
billing.other.description: Customers say they cannot play the specific song or part of a song they want, and that playback is forced into shuffle.

catalog.other.title: Missing songs and limited genre selection
catalog.other.description: Customers say many songs are absent from the catalog and that certain genres, such as gospel music, are poorly represented.

access.other.title: Cannot log into account
access.other.description: Customers say the app will not let them into their account, alongside complaints about ads.
access.other.note: Mixes account login failure with complaints about too many ads.

access.password_reset.title: Password rejected at login
access.password_reset.description: A customer reports the app will not accept their password when signing in.

catalog.lyrics.title: Lyrics missing or inconsistently shown
catalog.lyrics.description: Customers say lyrics are unavailable for some songs and sometimes fail to display even when expected.

downloads.offline_mode.title: Offline mode does not work
downloads.offline_mode.description: A customer reports that offline playback is not functioning.

billing.charges_refunds.title: Features moved behind premium paywall
billing.charges_refunds.description: A customer feels the app has become premium-focused to earn money and is less useful since a recent update.

billing.premium_only_feature.title: Song picking locked behind premium
billing.premium_only_feature.description: A customer reports that picking a specific song now requires premium and that skips are limited to six songs.

catalog.recommendations.title: Unwanted recommendations clutter the app
catalog.recommendations.description: A customer asks the app to stop showing recommendations.

downloads.other.title: Downloads stall until app is reopened
downloads.other.description: A customer reports that song downloads get stuck in the background and only resume once Spotify is opened.

playback.connection_error.title: Cannot connect to internet over Wi-Fi
playback.connection_error.description: A customer reports the app cannot connect to the internet when using Wi-Fi.

playback.stops_or_pauses.title: Playback stops halfway and loses position
playback.stops_or_pauses.description: A customer reports music keeps stopping partway and does not resume where it left off, starting a different song instead.

support.unhelpful.title: Rude or unhelpful support experience
support.unhelpful.description: A customer describes the app's support as rude.
